details:
getting kicked or banned is boring, but you know what is more boring? seeing the banned/kicked users just simply disappearing.

Idea

why not have something like magic effects of T posing and ascending, or even T posing and going down into the ground? or what else, maybe even a 920° Spin and resize to size 0m and disappear, or maybe it's a magician group so banning leaves.... magic particles!

Why

there is no animation at all when you execute moderator actions on users, such as kicking / banning, this would polish the platform a little more and it would let other users know what actually happened, at the moment you could kick someone and say that they went to sleep and manipulate an entire instance into believing that.

How

you can have at least 5 types of effects for bans and kicks so that people know who got kicked/banned, or maybe even muted effects, then maybe groups can choose what effect to apply for their moderator actions

Drama?

then just use the no-effect option and everything is back as before and no one knows who got banned or kicked.
title: Group Ban/Kick Animations
